sourceFrames.title:
One budget.
Across chains.
sourceFrames.caption: CommitBook counts pending commitments as well as completed payments. This recorded local run uses a 100-unit cap and valueless demo tokens.

sourceFrames.title:
A model proposes.
Review the terms.
sourceFrames.caption: Actual Qwen inference turns the purchase goal into a typed recommendation. Approved catalog terms and owner policy determine payment authority.

sourceFrames.title:
Reserve 60.
Spend nothing yet.
sourceFrames.caption: The coordinator reserves 60 units before the delayed grant reaches the vault. Available capacity falls to 40. The purchase counts before its supplier is paid.

sourceFrames.title:
The next 60
cannot fit.
sourceFrames.caption: A second 60-unit request would require 120 units in combined capacity. The runtime rechecks live capacity and blocks the proposal because only 40 units remain.

sourceFrames.title:
A lost receipt
keeps funds held.
sourceFrames.caption: The first operation closes, but its receipt is dropped. A late grant cannot reopen the closed permit. Capacity stays reserved until closure is verified.

sourceFrames.title:
Verify closure.
Release the 60.
sourceFrames.caption: Recovering the receipt alone still holds the reservation. The local finalizer confirms zero consumption and finalized closure. Only then does capacity return.

sourceFrames.title:
Pay 55 once.
A retry pays zero.
sourceFrames.caption: The approved replacement pays 55 units on the local Unichain EVM. Repeating execution transfers nothing. The final budget has 45 units available.

sourceFrames.title:
The public
loop is next.
sourceFrames.caption: The public AI proposal is prepared. The isolated test wallet still needs funding for Base Sepolia and Lasna. Public on-chain proof remains pending.
